prompt: Create a visually coherent, highly detailed abstract semi-translucent 2.5D crystalline celestial machine: a dense layered botanical-mechanical structure combining a luminous glass orrery, branching crystal vines, orbital rings, faceted leaves, tiny floating prisms, suspended droplets, delicate filigree, and glowing nodes. Rich overlapping transparent geometric forms, subtle refraction, intricate fine details, luminous teal, violet, rose-gold and icy blue gradients, dramatic depth, polished editorial concept-art composition on a dark indigo background. Deliberately organize it as many tightly coordinated, distinct spatial components across the canvas, with clear separations and layered overlaps suitable for numerous bounding-box regions. No text, no labels, no lettering.
